name: Petz.lol
author: Addicting Games
description: Petz.lol is a free iogame. Sometimes it's just you, your fists, and an angry army of heckin' puppers who are heck-bent on devouring the living. If you want to survive you'll need more than just your wits. Collect various items, ammunition, and upgrades that will put you one notch above the rest. At first, you think you can take the pet-patrol on one at a time. But you'll quickly realize that it's never just one on one. As soon as you enter into battle the other pets will get wind and they begin to snipe at you, they begin to swirl around you and tear you apart. This is why you need to think ahead and move fast. Collect your weapons, take potshots at the pets from behind. Its never a fair fight anyway so why pretend. Get good with your weapons because you're not going to be able to punch your way out of this one. Stay frosty as you avoid any dead-end entanglements. And watch out for the catz.
